# Smelter

**Homepage:** [https://avkiev.kiev.ua/Siemens/Smelter/Smelter_ru.htm](https://web.archive.org/web/20130401035858/https://avkiev.kiev.ua/Siemens/Smelter/Smelter_ru.htm) (web archive)<br/>
**Author:** avkiev<br/>
**Platforms:** x35/x45/x55 (EGOLD), x65/x75 (SGOLD)

<div className="screenshot">

![Smelter: screenshot 1](./smelter/img/smelter.png)

</div>

This program is intended for analyzing a phone fullflash. It extracts EEPROM,
language pack, menu, pictures, melodies, files, and much more from the ff, and
then displays them in a convenient form. The program is optimized for the 55
series, but in theory it should also work correctly with fullflashes from other
phones. It was originally intended for flash diggers, but may also be useful to
inexperienced users.

Features:

- Displaying information found in the ff;
- Viewing, importing, and exporting EEPROM blocks, decoding the contents of
  individual blocks, creating backups, and determining the IMEI;
- Viewing and editing the language pack, importing and saving the entire
  language pack or its area;
- Exploring the menu system and finding entry points for elements;
- Viewing and exporting pictures from the ff;
- Viewing, listening to, importing, and exporting melodies;
- Viewing the contents of flex memory and exporting files;
- Graphical ff block view;
- Viewing the address book of x45–x65;
- Searching for bytes with a mask and alignment, searching for text;
- Creating a VKP patch from ff changes and launching V_Klay;
- Saving lists in text format and IDC files for IDA, searching within lists,
  and integration with WinHex or HexWorkshop;
- Multilingual interface;
- ff viewer, standard Windows calculator, and separate Calc166;
- Searching for standard functions by signatures specified in the ini file;
- Generating standard patches by signatures specified in the ini file;
- Finding boot keys and creating a loader for V_Klay;
- Brute-force PhoneID search;
- Searching for master codes for unlocking;
- Enabling additional menus in WinSwup;
- Creating certificates and signing midlets without Java;
- Disarm, MicroAsm, working with the function library and scripts;
- Checking and stripping elves.

For the program to work correctly, the OCX components from the OCX Control
package included in the additional files are required.
